CENTRAL POLICE Station.
November 16 1920
REDUCTION Daily Report.
Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence.

Sir,
It is reported in the "Russian Echo" of 14th instant that the Diplomatic Corps in Peking has approved of the request of Russian merchants that Mr. Grosse be permitted to continue his functions in Shanghai.
The polling for the committee of the Old Amalgamated Association of Street Unions was concluded in their headquarters No. 13 Avenue Edward VII, French Concession, on 15th instant, when the following were elected officers for the coming year :-
President, Yuan Li Tung(袁履登), prominent member of the Ningpo Guild, member of the committee of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, member of the committee of the Chinese Ratepayers Association, and member of the committee of the National Citizens Convention Organization.
Vice Presidents; Lu Zing Tsar(呂靜), member of the committee of the Chinese Ratepayers Association, and Vice Chairman of the Hankow Road Street Union;
Pan Lien Shen(潘勵紳), a prominent member of the Nanking Road Street Union.
Treasurers; Wu Ts Hou(鄔志豪), a prominent member of Fokien Road Street Union, and Foong Ts Ching(馮志卿), a prominent member of the Street Unions of the Northern Part of the City.
A sub-committee of four was also appointed to make arrangements for the transfer of the control of the Association from the old to the new committee. The members of the sub-committee are:
Chang Ping Shen(張炳臣), member of Canton Road Street Union,
Fee Liang Hung(費良衡), member of Cunningham Rd Street Union

1920年11月16日
减缩日报。
由 D. I. Givens 编制，经刑事情报处处长转呈。

先生：
据本月14日《俄罗斯回声报》（Russian Echo）报道，北京外交团已批准俄国商人的请求，允许格罗斯先生（Mr. Grosse）继续在上海履行其职务。
老马路各业公会联合会（Old Amalgamated Association of Street Unions）委员会的投票选举于本月15日在其位于法租界爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）13号的总部结束，下列人员当选为下一年度的职员：
会长，袁履登，宁波同乡会知名成员，上海总商会委员，华人纳税会委员，国民大会组织筹备会委员。
副会长；呂靜（音译），华人纳税会委员，汉口路各业公会副主席；
潘勵紳（音译），南京路各业公会知名成员。
司库；鄔志豪（音译），福建路各业公会知名成员，以及馮志卿（音译），北市各业公会知名成员。
另任命了一个四人小组委员会，负责安排将协会的控制权从旧委员会移交给新委员会的事宜。小组成员如下：
張炳臣（音译），广东路各业公会成员，
費良衡（音译），康脑脱路（Cunningham Rd）各业公会成员

Wong Shao Shen(王肇成), member of Seward Road Street Union,
Zung Sih Tshung(戎寅春), member of Chapel Road Street Union.
Mr. Chen Char Koo(鄭鶴鳴), a prominent member of
Shantung Road Street Union, took charge of the polling arrange-
ments, in which task he was assisted by thirty five representa-
tives of various Street Unions.
A Committee meeting of the Boycott "Bad" Goods Society
was held in its headquarters, No. 15 Sah Ts Loong(薩珠弄),
inside Old North Gate, Chinese City, at 2 p.m. 14th instant,
seven delegates from the Chinese Industrial Progressive Associa-
tion, who were present, requested that a representative of the
society named Mao Shee Ying(繆稽英), who had created a dis-
turbance and made himself generally obnoxious when enquiring
regarding "bad" goods in the San Koh(三角) towel factory,
should be dismissed. The delegates threatened that their
society would cease to recognize the Boycott "Bad" Goods Society
in case their request was ignored. A lengthy discussion
then took place and it was arranged to call a general meeting
of the members of the Society to decide the course to be
adopted. The meeting broke up at 5.40 p.m.
Some 3,500 female workers have lost their employment as
a result of a decision reached at a meeting of silk filature
proprietors held at No. 51 N. Soochow Road on 15th instant to
close down their mills temporarily in order to maintain present
prices of silk which show signs of falling as a result of the
supplies of the commodity in question exceeding the demand.

关于________________________的报告

编制人________________________转呈人________________________

王肇成（音译），西华德路（Seward Road）各业公会成员，
戎寅春（音译），教堂路（Chapel Road）各业公会成员。
鄭鶴鳴（音译），山东路各业公会知名成员，负责主持投票安排工作，三十五名来自各业公会的代表协助其完成了此项任务。
抵制“劣货”社委员会会议于本月14日下午2时在该社位于华界老北门内萨珠弄15号的总部举行，出席会议的中国工业协进会七名代表要求罢免该社一名名为繆稽英（音译）的代表，此人在三角毛巾厂查询“劣货”情况时制造骚乱，引起普遍反感。代表们威胁称，若其要求被忽视，该会将不再承认抵制“劣货”社。随后进行了长时间讨论，并决定召开社员大会以决定采取的行动方针。会议于下午5时40分解散。
由于本月15日在北苏州路51号举行的缫丝厂主会议决定暂时关闭工厂，以维持呈现下跌迹象的生丝价格（下跌原因是该商品供过于求），约3,500名女工因此失业。
